content.subject: Quick thought on month-end close
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,
I saw ShipMonk’s post welcoming you as CFO.
That might mean month-end close will feel tighter than before.
If the close drags, the finance team may spend extra hours on manual matching.
Our platform reads transaction data from ERP and shipping systems, then matches entries to eliminate manual reconciliation.
I could be wrong.
Do you have 15 minutes next week to discuss?
Zamp
